notes: Open-source cloud security posture management (CSPM) check catalog and assessment tool (Apache-2.0) covering AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365, and GitHub. Prowler check IDs are widely cited in cloud security findings, posture reports, and compliance crosswalks (CIS Benchmarks, NIST 800-53, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ENS, NIS2, MITRE ATT&CK).

data.description: Catalog of 1,000+ automated cloud security posture checks across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Microsoft 365, and GitHub, each with a canonical snake_case check ID, risk statement, audit logic, remediation steps, and compliance framework mappings.
data.notes: Published under Apache-2.0 in github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler and indexed at hub.prowler.com. Check IDs follow <service>_<resource>_<check_name> snake_case naming (e.g., s3_bucket_public_access, iam_root_mfa_enabled).
